name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (gfx/blit domain). Accurately describes the function: a raw (uncompressed, no-transparency) sprite blit driven by the sprite's own width/height header. No Ghidra address residue. Matches body (reads ushort width/height header, REP MOVSB width bytes per row) and the single caller fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset which resolves an atlas entry and paints it opaquely.
purpose: Generic raw (uncompressed, no-transparency) sprite blit: copies every pixel including zero, using the sprite header's leading width/height words; smallest variant of the blit family.
logic_summary: width = *(ushort*)sprite_hdr; height = *(ushort*)(sprite_hdr+2); src = sprite_hdr+4 (skip 4-byte header). Post-test do/while row loop: memmove(dst, src, width); src += width (pixels stored contiguously); dst += stride (row base advances by stride). height=0 still paints one row (matches binary DEC DX; JNZ tail). Binary wraps body in PUSHAD/POPAD so EAX is untouched -> decompiler 'return in_EAX' is a signature artifact -> truly void; sole caller discards. Hand-written asm leaf: no __CHK probe, no CALLs.
signature: void fd2_blit_sprite_raw_with_header(uint32 dst, uint32 sprite_hdr, uint32 stride)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (row base). [EBP+8] -> EDI; restored to row base each row then advanced by stride.
params.reason: Clear, matches body usage as destination row base; no address residue.

params.name: sprite_hdr
params.semantics: Sprite header pointer: ushort width (word 0), ushort height (word 2), then width*height raw pixel bytes (row-major). [EBP+0xc] -> ESI; two LODSW read width/height then ESI points at pixels.
params.reason: Accurately names the header+pixels pointer; matches body and the atlas-resolved sprite address passed by the caller; no address residue.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Bytes to advance dst per row (destination row stride). [EBP+0x10] -> EBX; ADD EDI,EBX after each row.
params.reason: Correctly describes the per-row dst advance; matches caller's dst_pitch argument; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. The decompiler's 'return in_EAX' is a pass-through artifact: PUSHAD/POPAD wrap the body so EAX is never written; the sole caller discards any result.

notes: Decompile + disassembly + plate + src comment all mutually consistent and accurate. Disassembly @0x4e9bb confirms: PUSHAD/POPAD (EAX untouched, truly void), two LODSW (width->BP, height->DX), PUSH EDI / REP MOVSB CX=width / POP EDI / ADD EDI,EBX(stride) / DEC DX;JNZ (post-test do/while). src 'dst += stride' correctly models PUSH/POP EDI + ADD EDI,stride because memmove takes dst by value (does not advance it) whereas REP MOVSB does. No reads/writes of any global. Live Ghidra signature still uses param_1/2/3 (generic); src declaration already carries the good names dst/sprite_hdr/stride, judged on actual usage = all keep. No rename, no comment change, no plate change applied (this stage records only). Source comment block at blitspr.c lines 1025-1061 left untouched.
